    {
      "@type": "FAQPage",
      "@id": "https://www.hamiltonrock.com/faq#webpage",
      "url": "https://www.hamiltonrock.com/faq",
      "name": "FAQ - Hamilton Rock",
      "description": "Frequently asked questions about Hamilton Rock accounts, banking services, payments, transfers, spend cards, cashback, rewards, cash flow tools, eligibility, security, pricing and support.",
      "isPartOf": {
        "@id": "https://www.hamiltonrock.com/#website"
      },
      "about": {
        "@id": "https://www.hamiltonrock.com/#organization"
      },
      "publisher": {
        "@id": "https://www.hamiltonrock.com/#organization"
      },
      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What is Hamilton Rock?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Hamilton Rock is a financial technology company built for U.S. ecommerce businesses. It helps businesses manage money in one platform with financial accounts, AI cash-flow tools, global payments and access to fair and fast capital."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Who is Hamilton Rock for?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Hamilton Rock is built for U.S. ecommerce businesses that sell goods and services online, including businesses using websites, online stores, marketplaces and payment platforms."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Is Hamilton Rock a bank?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No. Hamilton Rock is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services are provided through trusted partners, including Fifth Third Bank, Celtic Bank, Visa U.S. and Stripe."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Are my funds protected?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Funds are securely held at Hamilton Rock's partner bank, Fifth Third Bank, Member FDIC. Hamilton Rock accounts are eligible for FDIC pass-through deposit insurance of up to $250,000 per business entity, provided applicable FDIC requirements are met."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Does Hamilton Rock charge monthly fees?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No. Hamilton Rock charges $0 monthly fees, $0 minimum balance fees, $0 account maintenance fees and $0 transaction fees. ATM provider fees may apply if you withdraw cash from an ATM."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What type of business can open a Hamilton Rock account?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Hamilton Rock accounts are available for registered U.S. businesses that sell goods or services online, including sole proprietorships, LLCs, corporations, partnerships and other legally registered business entities."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can I connect my ecommerce stores and payment platforms?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. Hamilton Rock lets ecommerce businesses connect stores and payment platforms in a few clicks, helping track platform KPIs, payouts and financial data from one platform."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can I connect my accounting software?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. Hamilton Rock will allow users to connect popular accounting software, including QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks and other major platforms, helping keep financial data accurate and up to date."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How does the 1.5% cashback card work?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Hamilton Rock provides a business spend card that earns 1.5% cashback on qualified purchases. Cashback is calculated on completed transactions and paid into the Hamilton Rock account each month, subject to the Cashback Terms."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How do you contact support?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Hamilton Rock support can be contacted by email at alexander@hamiltonrock.com, by phone on +1 (516) 336-4214, or through live chat in the Hamilton Rock dashboard."
          }
        }
      ],
      "inLanguage": "en-US"
    }
  ]
}
</script>

<script>
window.FinsweetAttributes ||= [];

window.FinsweetAttributes.push([
  'list',
  () => {
    const filterInputs = document.querySelectorAll(
      '[fs-list-element="filters"] input[type="checkbox"]'
    );

    if (!filterInputs.length) return;

    // Start with the first filter checked
    const firstInput = filterInputs[0];

    if (!firstInput.checked) {
      firstInput.click();
    }

    // Make checkboxes behave like radio buttons
    filterInputs.forEach((input) => {
      input.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (!input.checked) {
          input.click();
          return;
        }

        filterInputs.forEach((otherInput) => {
          if (otherInput !== input && otherInput.checked) {
            otherInput.click();
          }
        });
      });
    });
  },
]);
</script>
